M-01.native_description: BaseV1Factory.setPeriodSize(uint256) (src/Swap/BaseV1-core.sol#560-568) has external calls inside a loop: BaseV1Pair(allPairs[i]).setPeriodSize(newPeriod) (src/Swap/BaseV1-core.sol#565)
M-01.rule_description: Calls inside a loop might lead to a denial-of-service attack.

M-02.native_description:
BaseV1Router01.getPriceLP(IBaseV1Pair) (src/Swap/BaseV1-periphery.sol#549-593) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- token0TVL = assetReserves[i] * (prices[i] / decimals) (src/Swap/BaseV1-periphery.sol#582)
M-02.rule_description: Solidity's integer division truncates. Thus, performing division before multiplication can lead to precision loss.
